editor.dragToResizeDouble: Drag to resize · double-click: default width
editor.firewallOpenedForHome: Firewall opened for the home network ✓
editor.forPhonesToFind: For phones to find and reach TouchDeck, it has to be opened for your home network. One click does it (asks for your password) – or by hand in a terminal:
editor.noNetworkFoundIs: No network found. Is the PC connected to Wi-Fi/LAN?
editor.openAppItFinds: Open the app – it finds this PC by itself, you confirm here.
editor.pinIsSetPhone: 🔐 A PIN is set – the phone asks for it when connecting for the first time.

editor.scanThisCodeWith: scan this code with the phone camera, the deck opens in the browser.

deck.holdPhoneSidewaysFor: ↻ Turn the device sideways for this page
deck.notPairedPleaseScan: Not paired. Please scan the QR code in the TouchDeck editor on the PC.
deck.pinIsWrongPlease: The PIN is wrong. Please try again.
deck.thisPcIsProtected: This PC is protected with a PIN.

pages.allInstalledSteamGames: All installed Steam games with cover. A game lights up while it is running; at the bottom library, downloads, Big Picture and friends.
pages.alreadyThereClickTo: Already there – click to update or open
pages.buttonDoesntFitAt: The button doesn't fit at that size – other buttons or the edge are in the way.
pages.buttonReactsToEvents: The button reacts to events itself – e.g. change its color or label (“Visuals” → “this button”) when a value changes or OBS goes live.
pages.buttonSLieOutside: {0} button(s) lie outside the new grid and will be removed. Continue?
pages.buttonsDontFitGrid: {0} button(s) do not fit into the grid and will be removed. Switch anyway?
pages.clickEmptyFieldNew: Double-click an empty field = new button · drag to move or swap · right-click for more · Ctrl+C/X/V copies, cuts, pastes · Ctrl+D duplicates · Del deletes
pages.copiedPasteWithCtrl: {0} copied – paste with Ctrl+V or right-click › Paste
pages.cutPasteWithCtrl: {0} cut – paste with Ctrl+V or right-click › Paste
pages.displayHint: A display does not react to taps – good for live values and graphs. With “Transparent” only the content stays on the page; on free pages any size.
pages.doublePressHint: Tap twice quickly. If a button has double-press actions, the deck waits briefly (0.3 s) after a tap for a second one – a toggle does not switch on a double press.
pages.firstLineOfOutput: The first line of the output is shown (refreshed every 5 seconds).
pages.folderCreated: Folder created: page “{0}” with a back button ✓
pages.freeHint: Double-click the area or “＋ Button” = new button · drag to move · bottom-right corner resizes · arrow keys nudge (with Shift further)
pages.freeLayoutHint: Free page: buttons sit freely on the area. Set the format (e.g. 16:10) at the top – ideally matching the device.
pages.freeSizeHint: Values are percent of the page. On phone and tablet the area is fitted in the chosen format.
pages.graphHint: The history is recorded even when the page is not open. Bigger buttons (several cells) show it better. Example: 60 values every 2 seconds = the last 2 minutes.
pages.imageIsLargerThan: The image is larger than 5 MB.
pages.labelWhenOnEmpty: Label when on (empty = same as normal)
pages.leaveEmptySameIcon: Leave empty = same icon as normal.
pages.lightsUpWhenMicrophone: Lights up when the microphone is muted.
pages.lightsUpWhenScene: Lights up when the scene from the action “Switch scene” is live.
pages.lightsUpWhenValue: Lights up when the value is “on”, “yes”, “true” or 1. Tip: in the label {Name} shows the value as well.
pages.lightsUpWhileGame: Lights up while the game from the action “Start game” is running.
pages.logicCopied: Logic copied – right-click another button › “Paste logic” to apply it.
pages.longPressFromAbout: A long press (from about 0.5 s) runs these actions instead of the normal ones. When you let go afterwards, the ones below run.
pages.lookCopiedApplyIt: Look copied – apply it to other buttons with right-click › Paste look
pages.nothingToPasteCopy: Nothing to paste – copy a button first (right-click › Copy).
pages.obsIsNotReachable:
OBS is not reachable right now – you can choose the scene buttons later.
{0}
pages.obsSceneValueDescription: Active scene in OBS – set by the event “OBS: remember active scene”. The scene buttons on the OBS page compare against it.
pages.onIsReportedBy: “On” is reported by the live display, e.g. volume: on = muted.
pages.oneButtonPerObs: One button per OBS scene (lights up when live), plus stream, recording, pause and clip.
pages.pageLogicHint: Events for the whole page – e.g. “Page opened” → switch OBS scene or set a value. “Page opened / left” without a page selected means this page.
pages.pageWithClockCpu: A page with clock, CPU, RAM, temperature, music, sound, microphone, audio output, screenshot, night light, lock and a volume slider.
pages.pluginPageHint: Ready-made page from the plugin “{0}” – it is added, nothing is overwritten.
pages.profileImported: Profile imported: {0} page(s), {1} flow(s), {2} value(s), {3} image(s) ✓
pages.runActionsOnPc: Run the actions on the PC now
pages.selectButtonOrClick: Select a button or double-click an empty field to create a new one.
pages.seriesHint: Every series gets its own colour; the legend shows the names. Plugins can also deliver several series themselves with “series” (e.g. per power producer) – the lines are created automatically.
pages.shortTapRunsThese: A short tap runs these actions, a long press the ones under “Hold”.
pages.shortcutExample:
# Example
Undo = ctrl+z | ↩️
Redo = ctrl+shift+z | ↪️
Save = ctrl+s | 💾
Copy = ctrl+c | 📄
Paste = ctrl+v | 📋
pages.shortcutIntro: One line per button: “Label = shortcut”, optionally with “| symbol”. The buttons send the shortcuts to the chosen program. Lists can be shared as text files.
pages.sizesHint: 1 = normal, 2 = twice as big, 0.5 = half as big. This way a slider gets a wide column and a separator column stays narrow.
pages.sliderShapeHint: Slider: swipe over the button (vertical if the button is taller than wide). Knob: turn in a circle – bottom left is 0 %, bottom right 100 %.
pages.steamPageSCreated:
{0} Steam page(s) created ✓
The buttons light up green while a game is running.
pages.steamPageSUpdated:
{0} Steam page(s) updated ✓
The buttons light up green while a game is running.
pages.swipeOverButtonOn: Swipe over the button on the phone to set the value. If the button is taller than wide, the slider is vertical.
pages.textureHint: The background image sits below icon and label, the background colour as a light veil on top. Overlays also work without an image.
pages.thereArePagesFrom: There are {0} pages from this template.
pages.thereIsNoFree: There is no free field left on this page.
pages.thereIsNoFree2: There is no free field left on “{0}”.
pages.twoButtonsCantBe: The two buttons can't be swapped because of their size.
pages.updatingCreatesItAnew: Updating creates it anew – your own changes to it are lost, links from other pages are kept.
pages.webBadUrl: ⚠️ The address must start with http:// or https://.
pages.webBlocked: ⚠️ This site forbids being embedded in other pages – it stays empty in the button. TouchDeck cannot get around that.
pages.webHint: Some sites forbid embedding (the button stays empty then). Works well: own dashboards, Home Assistant, weather or status pages in the home network.
pages.webUnreachable: ⚠️ The site cannot be reached from the PC right now.
pages.withPreviewYouSee: With “Preview” you see the deck the way it appears on the phone.

actions.chooseNameOrEnter: Choose a name or enter a new one
actions.clickActionOnLeft: Click an action on the left or drag it into the flow · drag at ⠿ in the flow to reorder
actions.clickActionOnLeft2: Click an action on the left or drag it here.
actions.clickToAddOr: {0} – click to add or drag into the flow
actions.noToggleButtons: Only buttons with the behavior “Toggle” appear here (select a button › Size & behavior). To change the look depending on a state, a live display with “When on” is often enough.
actions.thereIsNothingLike: There is nothing like this in OBS yet. Create it in OBS, then click ⟳.
actions.thisActionWasImported: This action was imported and has no counterpart in TouchDeck yet. Disable or replace it.
actions.typeKeysNow: Press the keys now – pauses are recorded too …

flows.buttonOrEventCalls: A button or event calls them with “Logic › Run flow” – also several times in a row (repeat).
flows.flowsAreActionLists: Flows are action lists you build once and reuse everywhere.
flows.inputDefault: Default value (if the call leaves it empty)
flows.inputsHint: Values that “Run flow” passes on. Use them in the flow as {Input.Name}, e.g. a scene or a text.
flows.notUsedAnywhereYet: Not used anywhere yet. Add “Run flow” to a button or event.
flows.runWithDefaults: Run now – inputs get their default values

events.cooldownInSeconds0: Cooldown in seconds (0 = none) – how often the event may run at most
events.eventsRunActionsAutomatically: Events run actions automatically – without anyone pressing a button.
events.forExampleWhenObs: For example: “When the OBS stream starts, switch scene and post a chat note”, “Every day at 18:00 turn the music down” or “When the value Goals gets bigger than 3, play a sound”.
events.nameOfEventSwitch: Name of the event (e.g. “Switch scene when the stream starts”):
events.runActionsNowWithout: Run the actions now without waiting for the trigger

values.addToFolder: Create a new value in this folder
values.createOneOrUse: Create one or use “Set value” in an action – it then shows up here.
values.folderName: Folder name (e.g. “Stream”). Then you create the first value in it.
values.newNameForAll: New name for “{0}”. All uses are updated as well.
values.yourOwnVariablesFor: Your own variables – for counting, remembering and showing. In labels and texts {Name} shows the current content.

iconpacks.buttonColorHint: When an image from this pack is chosen for a button with the default colour, the button gets this colour.
iconpacks.buttonSUseImages: {0} button(s) use images from it and will show no image afterwards.
iconpacks.clickImageToName: Click an image: give it a name and tags (for search) or set it as cover.
iconpacks.exampleCc0CcBy: e.g. CC0, CC BY 4.0, private use only
iconpacks.iconSavedOwn: Icon saved: {0} (selectable under “Own images” on a button) ✓
iconpacks.licenseTextPlaceholder: Who may use the images for what?
iconpacks.packsImported: Imported {0} icon packs with {1} images in total ✓
iconpacks.stillEmptyUseAdd: Still empty – use “Add images” to choose several images at once.
iconpacks.yourOwnImageCollections: Your own image collections for your buttons. Create packs, add images and share them as a .tdicons file – or import packs from others. Please only use images you are allowed to use (made by yourself or with a suitable license).

plugins.actionSTriggerS: {0} action(s), {1} trigger(s) – in the action editor under “Plugins › {2}”.
plugins.advancedModeIsOn: Advanced mode is on (at your own risk)
plugins.advancedModeTurnedOff: Advanced mode turned off – plugins with full rights are stopped.
plugins.advancedPluginSInstalled: {0} advanced plugin(s) installed – blocked while the mode is off.
plugins.advancedPluginsTooOnly: Advanced plugins, too, only come from public GitHub repos (or from a folder of your own in test mode). Each one has to be confirmed again when it is installed.
plugins.extensionsByOthersNew: Extensions by others: new actions and triggers. Plugins are sandboxed and may only do what they declare when installed.
plugins.folderOrPublicGithub: A folder (or a public GitHub repo) with plugin.json and plugin.js. The full guide with examples for regular and advanced plugins is in the
plugins.forDevelopmentLoadPlugin: For development: load a plugin directly from a folder on this PC before it is published on GitHub. After changes click “Reload”. The same limits apply as for installed plugins.
plugins.inAdvancedModePlugins:
In advanced mode plugins may bring their own programs. These run with full rights: they can read and delete files, start programs and send data to the internet. TouchDeck cannot restrict or check them.

This happens at your own risk. Only install plugins whose source code you have looked at or whose developer you trust.
plugins.isProgramOfIts:
“{0}” is a program of its own and can do everything on your PC that you can: read and delete files, start programs, send data to the internet. TouchDeck cannot restrict it.

Only install it if you really trust the source: {1}
plugins.noPluginsInstalledYet: No plugins installed yet. You find some in the marketplace – or enter a GitHub repo.
plugins.notInMarketplaceNot: ⚠️ Not in the marketplace – not reviewed, install at your own risk.
plugins.notStatedAllRights: not stated (all rights reserved by the author)
plugins.notTurnedOnText: Not turned on – the text doesn't match.
plugins.pageImportedHint: The page is now in the page list.
plugins.pluginsAreSandboxedAnd: Plugins are sandboxed and can only do what is listed above. Still, only install plugins whose source you trust.
plugins.pluginsHaveToBe: Plugins have to be public on GitHub – so everyone can check the source. The latest release is installed, otherwise the default branch.
plugins.regularPluginsAreSandboxed: Regular plugins are sandboxed. Advanced plugins are programs of their own (e.g. in Python or Node.js) that TouchDeck starts – as powerful as plugins of other macro and streaming programs, but therefore also able to do harm.
plugins.testPluginFromFolder: Test a plugin from a folder
plugins.thereAreNoPlugins: There are no plugins in the marketplace yet. How to add yours is explained in the
plugins.thisPluginIsProgram: This plugin is a program of its own with full rights. Such plugins only run in advanced mode (Plugins › Advanced), which you have to enable deliberately and at your own risk.
plugins.toTurnItOn: To turn it on, please type “{0}”:
plugins.willBeRemovedButtons: “{0}” will be removed. Buttons with actions of this plugin will report an error afterwards.

settings.actionsFromVisualsChange: Actions from “Visuals” change buttons at runtime. Here you restore the original look everywhere.
settings.actionsUnderCommunicationDiscord: Actions under “Communication › Discord”, triggers in events, live displays “Discord: muted?”, “deafened?”, “voice channel”. TouchDeck connects automatically as soon as Discord is running.
settings.allButtonsLookAs: All buttons look as designed again ✓
settings.allPairedPhonesWill: All paired phones will be disconnected and have to scan the QR code again.
settings.androidAppTurnsTo: The Android app turns to the chosen orientation right away. “Automatic” follows the device's rotation lock. In the browser the setting only applies in fullscreen.
settings.appliesToEditorDeck: Applies to the editor, the deck and the Android app. The system language is the default.
settings.backUpAutomaticallyOnce: Back up automatically once a day
settings.backupsOfPagesValues: Backups of pages, values, flows, events and settings.
settings.cellShapeHint: “Fill the screen” makes better use of the screen: cells may become a bit wider or taller than square. “Square” leaves more margin on some pages.
settings.clientIdConsistsOf: The client ID consists of digits only (about 19).
settings.clientIdOfYour: Client ID of your Twitch application
settings.createManageCopyClient: Create → “Manage” → copy the client ID and paste it here. You don't need a client secret.
settings.currentStateIsBacked: The current state is backed up automatically first. Afterwards “{0}” applies.
settings.discordIsNotOpen: · Discord is not open right now
settings.editorCanOnlyBe: The editor can only be reached on this PC. Phones need the key from the QR code – and, if set, the PIN.
settings.enterBothHereKeep: Enter both here, keep Discord open on the PC and click “Connect to Discord”. Discord shows a prompt – “Authorize”.
settings.everyoneConnectsTheirOwn: Everyone connects their own Twitch account via their own Twitch application. The login is only stored on this PC.
settings.extraProtectionWhoeverSees: Extra protection: whoever sees the QR code still needs the PIN. The phone asks for it once and remembers it.
settings.fileIsNotValid: The file is not a valid backup.
settings.howDeckBehavesOn: How the deck behaves on the phone.
settings.howDetailedTouchdeckLogs: How detailed TouchDeck logs. You see the entries in “Logs”; the file is logs/touchdeck.log in the data folder.
settings.howToGetClient: How to get a client ID (once, about 5 minutes)
settings.howToSetIt: How to set it up (once, about 3 minutes)
settings.inDesktopProgramYou: In the desktop program you set “Start at login” via the icon in the system tray.
settings.inObsEnableServer: In OBS enable the server under Tools → WebSocket Server Settings. “Take over from OBS” reads port and password directly from OBS (also Flatpak).
settings.onSamePageCopy: On the same page copy the “Client ID”, create a “Client Secret” with “Reset Secret” and copy it.
settings.pinMustConsistOf: The PIN must consist of 4 to 8 digits.
settings.pinSetPairedPhones: PIN set ✓ – paired phones will now ask for it.
settings.pleaseAlsoEnterClient: Please also enter the client secret.
settings.portAndPasswordTaken: Port and password taken over from OBS ✓
settings.registerYourApplicationAny: “Register Your Application”: any name (e.g. “TouchDeck by you”), OAuth redirect URL
settings.replacesCurrentStateWhich: “{0}” replaces the current state (which is backed up automatically first).
settings.showFooter: Show footer (connection, “Switch PC” in the app)
settings.signInWithYour: sign in with your Discord account and create a “New Application” (name e.g. “TouchDeck”).
settings.signInWithYour2: sign in with your Twitch account (Twitch requires two-factor authentication for this).
settings.takenOverButWebsocket: Taken over ✓ – but the WebSocket server in OBS is still off.
settings.thatDoesntLookLike: That doesn't look like a client ID (about 30 letters and digits).
settings.voiceControlOfDiscord: Voice control of the Discord program on this PC (mute, deafen, voice channel, volume). Everyone uses their own Discord application for it. Messages via webhook work without a connection, too.
settings.waitingForConfirmationCode: Waiting for confirmation … (the code is valid for about 30 minutes)
settings.youFindTwitchActions: You find Twitch actions under “Streaming › Twitch”, triggers in events; live displays “Twitch: live?”, “Viewers”, “Followers”.

logs.everythingTouchdeckDoesLive: Everything TouchDeck does – live. Errors of actions and events show up here first.
